reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program (Idaho, focus year 2021)
    Question: Whether the term "Warrant of ejectment" is used to refer to the court order
    to authorities to remove a tenant.

    Sources encoded:
      - ID Code  6-311 (2021)  (Continuance limits/undertaking)
      - ID Code  6-316 (2021)  (Judgment-restitution; writ of restitution; sheriff removal)
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Basic utilities (no external modules)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% simple numeric comparison helper (kept explicit for readability)
number_leq(A, B) :- number(A), number(B), A =< B.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute translations
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/*
  ID Code  6-311 (2021) - CONTINUANCE.
  In certain possession actions (tract <=5 acres, certain grounds), no continuance
  longer than 2 days unless defendant gives an undertaking with sufficient security
  approved by the court, conditioned on payment of accruing rent if judgment is
  rendered against defendant.
*/

% statute_6_311_action_qualifies(+Action)
% Action qualifies if it is exclusively for possession and tract <= 5 acres and
% based on one of the listed grounds.
% We model actions as action(ActionId) with facts describing attributes.
statute_6_311_action_qualifies(Action) :-
    action(Action),
    action_exclusively_for_possession(Action, yes),
    action_tract_acres(Action, Acres),
    number_leq(Acres, 5),
    ( action_ground(Action, nonpayment_of_rent)
    ; action_ground(Action, landlord_reasonable_grounds_controlled_substance)
    ; action_ground(Action, tenant_at_sufferance_45_1506_11)
    ).

% statute_6_311_max_continuance_days(+Action, -MaxDays)
statute_6_311_max_continuance_days(Action, 2) :-
    statute_6_311_action_qualifies(Action).

% statute_6_311_continuance_longer_requires_undertaking(+Action, +RequestedDays)
statute_6_311_continuance_longer_requires_undertaking(Action, RequestedDays) :-
    statute_6_311_action_qualifies(Action),
    statute_6_311_max_continuance_days(Action, MaxDays),
    number(RequestedDays),
    RequestedDays > MaxDays.

% statute_6_311_undertaking_condition(+Action, -Condition)
% The undertaking is conditioned for payment of accruing rent if judgment against defendant.
statute_6_311_undertaking_condition(Action, pay_accruing_rent_if_judgment_against_defendant) :-
    statute_6_311_action_qualifies(Action).


/*
  ID Code  6-316 (2021) - JUDGMENT - RESTITUTION.
  (1) If verdict/finding for plaintiff, judgment entered for restitution of premises.
      In certain unlawful detainer cases, judgment also declares forfeiture.
      Timing details for execution in certain >5 acre rent default cases.
  (2) If finding in favor of landlord for possession:
      - residential tenant: 72 hours to remove belongings
      - commercial tenant or tenant with tract >=5 acres: 7 days (court may extend for good cause for commercial)
      - landlord/agents may deliver a "writ of restitution" or give sheriff a copy and request sheriff deliver it
      - if requested, sheriff shall deliver writ of restitution
      - after the time to remove belongings and 3 days after finding, sheriff shall restore possession by causing immediate removal
*/

% statute_6_316_judgment_for_restitution_required(+Proceeding)
statute_6_316_judgment_for_restitution_required(Proceeding) :-
    proceeding(Proceeding),
    proceeding_trial_result(Proceeding, finding_for_plaintiff_against_defendant).

% statute_6_316_term_for_court_order_to_restore_possession(-Term)
% This statute uses the term "writ of restitution" for the instrument delivered/provided to sheriff.
statute_6_316_term_for_court_order_to_restore_possession(writ_of_restitution).

% statute_6_316_sheriff_restores_possession_by_removal(+Proceeding)
statute_6_316_sheriff_restores_possession_by_removal(Proceeding) :-
    proceeding(Proceeding),
    proceeding_trial_result(Proceeding, finding_for_landlord_for_possession),
    statute_6_316_term_for_court_order_to_restore_possession(writ_of_restitution),
    proceeding_writ_type_used(Proceeding, writ_of_restitution),
    proceeding_landlord_requested_sheriff_delivery(Proceeding, yes).

% statute_6_316_belongings_removal_hours(+TenancyType, +TractAcres, -Hours)
% Residential: 72 hours. Commercial OR tract >=5 acres: 7 days (=168 hours).
statute_6_316_belongings_removal_hours(residential, _TractAcres, 72) :- !.
statute_6_316_belongings_removal_hours(commercial, _TractAcres, 168) :- !.
statute_6_316_belongings_removal_hours(_OtherType, TractAcres, 168) :-
    number(TractAcres),
    TractAcres >= 5,
    !.

% statute_6_316_sheriff_removal_prerequisites_hours(+TenancyType, +TractAcres, -HoursForBelongings, -AdditionalDaysAfterFinding)
statute_6_316_sheriff_removal_prerequisites_hours(TenancyType, TractAcres, HoursForBelongings, 3) :-
    statute_6_316_belongings_removal_hours(TenancyType, TractAcres, HoursForBelongings).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Legal meaning helpers (bridging the question to statutory terms)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% legal_order_from_court_to_authorities_to_remove_tenant_term(+State, +Year, -OrderTerm)
% For Idaho 2021 under  6-316(2), the operative term is "writ of restitution".
legal_order_from_court_to_authorities_to_remove_tenant_term(idaho, 2021, OrderTerm) :-
    statute_6_316_term_for_court_order_to_restore_possession(OrderTerm).

% legal_term_used_for_that_order(+State, +Year, +CandidateTerm)
legal_term_used_for_that_order(State, Year, CandidateTerm) :-
    legal_order_from_court_to_authorities_to_remove_tenant_term(State, Year, CandidateTerm).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario (question) encoding
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% Jurisdiction focus facts
scenario_state(idaho).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% The question asks about the term and the meaning:
scenario_term_in_question(warrant_of_ejectment).
scenario_meaning_in_question(order_from_court_to_authorities_to_remove_tenant).

% scenario_statement/0 succeeds when the factual statement has been fully encoded.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(idaho),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_term_in_question(warrant_of_ejectment),
    scenario_meaning_in_question(order_from_court_to_authorities_to_remove_tenant).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Reasoning to answer the question (derive yes/no from statutes + scenario)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% scenario_matches_statutory_term/0:
% true if the term in the question is the term used in the statute for the relevant order.
scenario_matches_statutory_term :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    scenario_term_in_question(Term),
    % The meaning is "order from court to authorities to remove a tenant".
    scenario_meaning_in_question(order_from_court_to_authorities_to_remove_tenant),
    legal_term_used_for_that_order(State, Year, Term).

% housing_answer(-Result) where Result is yes/no, deterministic.
housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_matches_statutory_term,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is the term 'Warrant of ejectment' used to refer to the order from the court to the authorities to remove a tenant?
